title: 强化学习实现广泛且持久的对齐泛化
summary: 研究通过强化学习在现实领域训练有益行为（如诚实、公平、风险意识），发现模型能在超过80%的分布外基准上提升对齐性能，并表现出跨领域对齐迁移和对抗性攻击的持久性。
summary_en: This paper studies RL on beneficial behavior in realistic domains, showing improved alignment generalization on over 80% of out-of-distribution benchmarks, cross-domain transfer, and persistence against adversarial attacks.
